newsitem.title: USA: Applied Cellular EPS help from acquisition.
newsitem.headline: Applied Cellular EPS help from acquisition.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Tuesday it its recent acquisition of an 80 percent stake in Universal Commodities Corp will add a estimated $0.05 to earnings per share in 1997.
Universal Commodities is a computer parts supplier, recycler and third-party support vendor.

"We estimate that Universal Commodities will contribute approximately $6 million to revenues and operating earnings of $640,000 in 1997, reflecting a $0.05 per share increase in 1997 earnings," said Applied Cellular Chairman Richard Sullivan in a statement.

"This acquisition will create additional earnings growth capabilities in our other company subsidiaries as well as extend the capability to expand into much larger markets and achieve stronger operating margins," Sullivan said.
Applied Technology is a diversified computer software and cellular communications service company.
